{"rules": ["Model consistently underestimates volatility and fails to capture sudden upward spikes (e.g., +10-20 EUR jumps) even when sentiment is neutral or slightly positive.", "Forecasts exhibit a strong downward bias relative to true outcomes, often predicting flat trends while actual prices reverse sharply within the first 5 days of the horizon.", "Sentiment history shows no predictive power for immediate price direction; spikes occur regardless of prior sentiment scores.", "Model assumes mean reversion toward recent averages but fails to account for trend acceleration once a new high is formed.", "Correction heuristic: Add a volatility buffer (+8-12 EUR) and apply an upward bias multiplier when the first 3 days of true outcome deviate >5% from forecast."]
